chapterInfo.content:
16
Ɔman no sɛeɛ
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2Nware yere, na nnya mmabanin ne mmammaa wɔ ha yi. 3Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka no mmabanin ne mmammaa a wɔwo wɔn ha yi, ne wɔn nanom a wɔwɔ wɔn ne wɔn agyanom a wɔwo wɔn asase yi soɔ no ho nie: 4Owuyadeɛ bɛbobɔ wɔn ama wɔawuwu. Wɔrenyɛ wɔn ayie, na wɔrensie wɔn; wɔbɛdane sumina wɔ asase ani. Na afena ne ɛkɔm bɛdwerɛ wɔn, na wɔn afunu ayeyɛ ewiem nnomaa ne asase so mmoa aduane.
5Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Nhyɛne efie a wɔsu mu mu, na nkɔ ayie ase na nnyam wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ mayi m’asomdwoeɛ afiri ɔman yi so, AWURADE asɛm nie, mayi adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu. 6Na nnipa akɛseɛ ne nkumaa bɛwuwu asase yi so; wɔrensie wɔn na wɔrenyɛ wɔn ayie, na obiara remmɔ ne hɔ akam, obiara remmɔ tikwa mma wɔn, 7na wɔremmubu paanoo mma wɔn, ayie ase, sɛ wɔde rema wɔn due, owufoɔ no ho, na wɔremma wɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ kuruwa, obi n’agya ne ne na ho. 8Na nkɔ nsanom fie, nso wo ne wɔn nkɔtena ase nnidi nnom. 9#Yer 7.34 Na sɛdeɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Hwɛ, merema ahosɛpɛ nne, ne anigyeɛ nne, ayeforɔkunu nne, ne ayeforɔ nne to atwa ɛha yi, mo ani so ne mo berɛ yi so.
10Na ɛbɛba sɛ woka nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛ ɔman yi na wɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Adɛn nti na AWURADE ka adebɔne kɛseɛ yi gu yɛn soɔ yi, na ɛdeɛn ne yɛn amumuyɛ, anaasɛ ɛdeɛn ne yɛn bɔne a yɛayɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn no? 11Ɛnneɛ ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ mo agyanom agya me, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔakɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi asom wɔn asɔre wɔn, na me deɛ, wɔagya me, na me mmara nso, wɔanni so, 12#Yer 7.24-26 na mo nso, modi asɛmmɔne sene mo agyanom, na hwɛ, mo nyinaa monam di mo akoma bɔne denyɛ akyi a montie me, 13enti mɛto mo afiri asase yi so agu asase bi a mo ne mo agyanom nnim soɔ so, na moakɔsom anyame foforɔ wɔ hɔ, awia ne anadwo, ɛfiri sɛ merenhu mo mmɔbɔ.
Nkwagyeɛ ho nkɔmhyɛ
14 # Yer 23.7-8 Saa nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔrenka bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi, 15na mmom wɔbɛka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii atifi fam asase so, ne nsase a ɔpamm wɔn kɔɔ hɔ nyinaa soɔ no te aseɛ yi. Na mede wɔn bɛsane aba wɔn asase a mede memaa wɔn agyanom no so.
Apofofoɔ ne abɔmmɔfoɔ
16Hwɛ, mɛma wɔakɔfa apofofoɔ pii aba, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔakɔyi wɔn, na yei akyiri no mɛma wɔakɔfa abɔmmɔfoɔ pii aba na wɔakɔtwe wɔn afiri mmepɔ nyinaa so ne nkokoɔ nyinaa so ne abotan ntokuro mu. 17Na m’ani hwɛ wɔn akwan nyinaa, ɛnhunta me, na wɔn amumuyɛ nso, ɛso nkataa m’anim. 18Na mɛtua wɔn amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne so ka mmɔho, sɛ wɔagu m’asase ho fi, wɔde wɔn atantanneɛ ne wɔn akyiwadeɛ afunu ahyɛ m’agyapadeɛ no ma.
Nkwagyeɛ berɛ
19O AWURADE, m’ahoɔden ne m’aban denden,
me dwanekɔbea ahohiahia da mu,
wo nkyɛn na amanaman bɛfiri
asase anoano aba abɛka sɛ:
Atorɔ nko ne yɛn agyanom awunnyadeɛ no,
ahuhudeɛ a mfasoɔ nni mu.
20Onipa bɛyɛ anyame a
wɔnyɛ anyame afa?
21Ɛno nti, hwɛ, mɛma wɔahunu prɛko, mɛma wɔahunu m’ahoɔden ne me tumi, na wɔahunu sɛ, me din ne AWURADE.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Nware yere, na nnya mmabanin ne mmammaa wɔ ha yi. Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE ka no mmabanin ne mmammaa a wɔwo wɔn ha yi, ne wɔn nanom a wɔwɔ wɔn ne wɔn agyanom a wɔwo wɔn asase yi soɔ no ho nie: Owuyadeɛ bɛbobɔ wɔn ama wɔawuwu. Wɔrenyɛ wɔn ayie, na wɔrensie wɔn; wɔbɛdane sumina wɔ asase ani. Na afena ne ɛkɔm bɛdwerɛ wɔn, na wɔn afunu ayeyɛ ewiem nnomaa ne asase so mmoa aduane.
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Nhyɛne efie a wɔsu mu mu, na nkɔ ayie ase na nnyam wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ mayi m’asomdwoeɛ afiri ɔman yi so, AWURADE asɛm nie, mayi adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu. Na nnipa akɛseɛ ne nkumaa bɛwuwu asase yi so; wɔrensie wɔn na wɔrenyɛ wɔn ayie, na obiara remmɔ ne hɔ akam, obiara remmɔ tikwa mma wɔn, na wɔremmubu paanoo mma wɔn, ayie ase, sɛ wɔde rema wɔn due, owufoɔ no ho, na wɔremma wɔn awerɛkyekyerɛ kuruwa, obi n’agya ne ne na ho. Na nkɔ nsanom fie, nso wo ne wɔn nkɔtena ase nnidi nnom. Na sɛdeɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Hwɛ, merema ahosɛpɛ nne, ne anigyeɛ nne, ayeforɔkunu nne, ne ayeforɔ nne to atwa ɛha yi, mo ani so ne mo berɛ yi so.
Na ɛbɛba sɛ woka nsɛm yi nyinaa kyerɛ ɔman yi na wɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Adɛn nti na AWURADE ka adebɔne kɛseɛ yi gu yɛn soɔ yi, na ɛdeɛn ne yɛn amumuyɛ, anaasɛ ɛdeɛn ne yɛn bɔne a yɛayɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn no? Ɛnneɛ ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ mo agyanom agya me, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔakɔdi anyame foforɔ akyi asom wɔn asɔre wɔn, na me deɛ, wɔagya me, na me mmara nso, wɔanni so, na mo nso, modi asɛmmɔne sene mo agyanom, na hwɛ, mo nyinaa monam di mo akoma bɔne denyɛ akyi a montie me, enti mɛto mo afiri asase yi so agu asase bi a mo ne mo agyanom nnim soɔ so, na moakɔsom anyame foforɔ wɔ hɔ, awia ne anadwo, ɛfiri sɛ merenhu mo mmɔbɔ.

Saa nti, hwɛ, AWURADE asɛm nie, nna bi reba a wɔrenka bio sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no te aseɛ yi, na mmom wɔbɛka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE a ɔyii Israelfoɔ firii atifi fam asase so, ne nsase a ɔpamm wɔn kɔɔ hɔ nyinaa soɔ no te aseɛ yi. Na mede wɔn bɛsane aba wɔn asase a mede memaa wɔn agyanom no so.

Hwɛ, mɛma wɔakɔfa apofofoɔ pii aba, AWURADE asɛm nie, na wɔakɔyi wɔn, na yei akyiri no mɛma wɔakɔfa abɔmmɔfoɔ pii aba na wɔakɔtwe wɔn afiri mmepɔ nyinaa so ne nkokoɔ nyinaa so ne abotan ntokuro mu. Na m’ani hwɛ wɔn akwan nyinaa, ɛnhunta me, na wɔn amumuyɛ nso, ɛso nkataa m’anim. Na mɛtua wɔn amumuyɛ ne wɔn bɔne so ka mmɔho, sɛ wɔagu m’asase ho fi, wɔde wɔn atantanneɛ ne wɔn akyiwadeɛ afunu ahyɛ m’agyapadeɛ no ma.

O AWURADE, m’ahoɔden ne m’aban denden,
me dwanekɔbea ahohiahia da mu,
wo nkyɛn na amanaman bɛfiri
asase anoano aba abɛka sɛ:

wɔnyɛ anyame afa?
Ɛno nti, hwɛ, mɛma wɔahunu prɛko, mɛma wɔahunu m’ahoɔden ne me tumi, na wɔahunu sɛ, me din ne AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
